create_humanoid_env: create a Humanoid environment with a specified move speed and optional config overrides
run_humanoid_reset: run the Humanoid environment reset method with a JAX random number generator array
run_humanoid_step: run the Humanoid environment step method with a state and action array
get_humanoid_obs: get the observation array from the Humanoid environment containing joint angles, head height, extremities, torso orientation, and velocities
get_humanoid_reward: get the reward value from the Humanoid environment combining standing, upright, and move rewards with small control penalty
